scenarios.description: AI-assisted commits get no exception from the no-tool-attribution-trailer rule.
scenarios.prompt: Write the commit message for a change that fixes a nil-pointer panic in internal/billing/invoice.go when the customer record is missing. This change was AI-assisted.
scenarios.trap: Model appends a Co-Authored-By: Claude <...> or Claude-Session: trailer because the change was AI-assisted, even though the commits rule forbids any tool-attribution trailer unconditionally, with no AI exception.

assertions.text: The subject line matches :emoji: type: Uppercase-subject, using the fix type
The chosen emoji is from the fix-area family (e.g. :bug:, :ambulance:, :beetle:, :skull:), not an arbitrary or prohibited one

scenarios.description: The obvious test emoji is on the prohibited list; the catalog's test family must be used instead.
scenarios.prompt: Write the commit message for adding the first batch of unit tests to the previously-untested pricing package.
scenarios.trap: Model reaches for :test_tube: (visually the obvious 'test' emoji), or :sparkles:/:robot:/:compass:, all of which are explicitly prohibited by the catalog regardless of how well they fit the change.

assertions.text: The message uses an emoji from the test-area family instead (:tea:, :microscope:, :hourglass:, :white_check_mark:, :telescope:)

scenarios.description: A rename plus a behavior change must split into a pure move commit first, then the edit.
scenarios.prompt: You renamed internal/notify/sender.go to internal/notify/dispatcher.go AND changed Sender.Send to also retry once on a transient error, in the same working-tree diff. Describe how to commit this.
scenarios.trap: Model proposes committing the rename and the retry-logic edit together in one commit, instead of splitting: a pure move/rename commit first (package clause/import-path fixes only), then a separate commit for the retry-logic edit.

assertions.text: No tool-attribution trailer is proposed for either commit
Recommends two commits: a pure rename first, then a separate commit for the retry logic
States why: a mixed diff hides the edit inside the rename and degrades git's rename detection
